body:
> I would go for this for now then. Yes for the sort by price it makes sense. But here is another use case: I would love to use such widget to create a dropdown-menu filter: Sort by:
... v
By relevance
Only popular
Only whatever
The "Only popular" would target the same index than "Default", but add a numeric filter `popularity>1000`. I already implemented such thing. It can be another widget however.
